verdict.rationale: Linear documents building custom agents in the product ("Build agents that can investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback"). Loops let users describe a recurring agent job in plain language and set it to run on a schedule or in response to workspace events, including initiative, project and cycle changes. Shareable skills let teams turn personal workflows into standardized agent behavior, and the developer Agents platform adds a deeper route where custom agents become delegatable, mentionable workspace members. missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring agent instructions, tools and permissions in the in-product builder; independent or hands-on corroboration that custom agents and Loops work as claimed.
